preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 500,000, inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices within the range of vertex numbers.

preconditions.expression: The input graph is a tree (connected and acyclic).
preconditions.description: The input graph is a tree, meaning it is connected and contains no cycles.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the minimal time required for all ants to be in the root of the tree.

invariants.expression: all(len(children) <= 2 for node, children in tree.items() if node != root)
invariants.description: Each non-root node in the tree has at most two children.

invariants.expression: all(len(children) == 1 for node, children in tree.items() if node != root and len(children) == 1)
invariants.description: Each leaf node in the tree has exactly one child.
